Bad weather makes it more expensive.
The bus costs more during rush hour.

I recommend book them early.
I regret the date of your appointment.

intent: Atribua o horário à informação publicada.
Attribute the departure time to published information.

Segundo os horários publicados, o trem sai às nove.

replies: That's what the timetable says.
It's just my preference about the journey.
I like the train more than the bus.

According to identifies the source of the information.

intent: Apresente a mudança de data como possibilidade.
Present a date change as a possibility.

Nós precisamos mudar a data da reunião.

Nós mudamos a data da reunião ontem.

replies: No, we might change it.
Yes, might means it is certain.
No, we changed it yesterday.

Might expresses possibility, not certainty.

intent: Deduza cansaço após uma viagem longa.
Infer tiredness after a long journey.
sentences: He must be tired after that long journey.
Ele deve estar cansado depois daquela viagem longa.
He might be tired, but I have no evidence.
Ele talvez esteja cansado, mas não tenho evidências.
He has to finish his report before dinner.
Ele precisa terminar seu relatório antes do jantar.

replies: He must be tired after the journey.
He must finish a report, so he's not tired.
He cannot be tired because he travelled.

Must can mark a strong deduction based on evidence.

intent: Imagine aprender italiano se tivesse mais tempo.
Imagine learning Italian if you had more time.
sentences: If I had more time, I would learn Italian.

Eu aprendi italiano quando morei em Roma.
b1-hipoteses-03.scene: Jo: Imagine you had more free time. What would you do?
replies: I'd learn Italian.
I learned Italian last year.
I'll call you if I'm free tomorrow.

If + past and would express an imaginary situation.

intent: Apresente terminar cedo como condição possível.
Present finishing early as a realistic condition.
sentences: If I finish early, I will call you.
Se eu terminar cedo, eu vou ligar para você.
If I had more time, I would travel.
Se eu tivesse mais tempo, eu viajaria.
I called you after I finished work yesterday.
Eu liguei para você depois de terminar o trabalho ontem.
b1-hipoteses-04.scene: Jo: Can you call me today if work finishes early?
replies: Yes, if I finish early, I'll call.
Yes, I called you yesterday.
Only if I had finished last year.
note: If + presente apresenta uma condição futura possível.
If + present expresses a realistic future condition.

intent: Use unless para indicar como evitar perder o ônibus.
Use unless to explain how to avoid missing the bus.

Nós perderemos o ônibus a menos que saiamos agora.

Nós não perderemos o ônibus se sairmos agora.
We missed the bus because we left too late.
Nós perdemos o ônibus porque saímos tarde demais.
b1-hipoteses-05.scene: Jo: What does unless we leave now mean?
replies: If we don't leave now, we'll miss the bus.
If we leave now, we'll definitely miss the bus.
We already left and caught the bus yesterday.

Unless means if not.

intent: Prefira caminhar a esperar um táxi.
Prefer walking to waiting for a taxi.
sentences: I would rather walk than wait for a taxi.
Eu preferiria caminhar a esperar um táxi.
I prefer waiting here because my foot hurts.
Eu prefiro esperar aqui porque meu pé dói.

Nós decidimos pegar o próximo trem para casa.
b1-hipoteses-06.scene: Jo: Would you rather walk or wait for a taxi?
replies: I'd rather walk.
I'd rather to walk.
I walked here yesterday.
note: Would rather pede o verbo na forma base.
Would rather takes the base form of the verb.

intent: Identifique a colega pela ajuda de ontem.
Identify the colleague by yesterday's help.
sentences: She is the colleague who helped me yesterday.

This is the file that I sent yesterday.
Este é o arquivo que eu enviei ontem.
The colleague works in the office near school.
A colega trabalha no escritório perto da escola.
b1-precisao-01.scene: Jo: Which colleague do you mean?
replies: The one who helped me yesterday.
The file that arrived yesterday.
The one which I have not met.

Who refers to a person in a relative clause.

intent: Destaque a biblioteca como local que recebe a limpeza.
Focus on the library receiving the cleaning.

A biblioteca é limpa todas as manhãs antes de abrir.
The cleaner opens the library every morning.
O funcionário abre a biblioteca todas as manhãs.
The library was closed for repairs last week.
A biblioteca foi fechada para reparos na semana passada.
b1-precisao-02.scene: Jo: Is the library cleaned every morning?
replies: Yes, it is cleaned before opening.
Yes, it cleans itself every morning.
No, the cleaner opened it yesterday.
note: Is cleaned foca quem recebe a ação habitual.
Is cleaned focuses on the receiver of a habitual action.

intent: Noticie a inauguração da ponte no ano passado.
Report the bridge's opening last year.
sentences: The bridge was opened to traffic last year.
A ponte foi aberta ao tráfego no ano passado.
The bridge is inspected every month for safety.
A ponte é inspecionada todos os meses por segurança.
They will open the new bridge next month.
Eles vão abrir a ponte nova no mês que vem.
b1-precisao-03.scene: Jo: When was the bridge opened?
replies: It was opened last year.
It is opening next month.
It inspects the traffic every week.
note: Was opened situa a ação passiva no passado.
Was opened places the passive action in the past.

intent: Conte a decisão de sair antes do almoço.
Describe deciding to leave before lunch.
sentences: We decided to leave before lunch that day.
Nós decidimos sair antes do almoço naquele dia.
She enjoys cooking lunch for her friends.
Ela gosta de preparar o almoço para seus amigos.
They avoided travelling during the busiest holiday weekend.
Eles evitaram viajar durante o fim de semana mais movimentado do feriado.
b1-precisao-04.scene: Jo: What did you decide to do?
replies: We decided to leave before lunch.
We decided leaving before lunch.
We enjoy leaving yesterday before lunch.

Decide is followed by to + verb.

intent: Peça para desligar o aparelho antes de sair.
Ask someone to switch the device off before leaving.

Por favor, desligue isso antes de sair de casa.
Please turn the music down during the meeting.
Por favor, abaixe a música durante a reunião.
She turned on the light when she arrived.
Ela acendeu a luz quando chegou.
b1-precisao-05.scene: Jo: Where does it go in turn off?
replies: Between turn and off: turn it off.
After off: turn off it.
Before turn: it turn off.
note: O pronome fica entre turn e off.
The pronoun goes between turn and off.

intent: Diga que ela tem interesse em aprender fotografia.
Say she is interested in learning photography.
sentences: She is interested in learning photography this year.
Ela tem interesse em aprender fotografia este ano.
He is good at explaining difficult ideas clearly.
Ele é bom em explicar ideias difíceis claramente.
We are worried about missing the last train.
Nós estamos preocupados em perder o último trem.
b1-precisao-06.scene: Jo: Is Lia interested in photography?
replies: Yes, she's interested in learning it.
Yes, she's interested to learning it.
No, he's good at explaining it.
note: Interested combina com in; depois da preposição, use -ing.
Interested takes in; after the preposition, use -ing.

intent: Peça para explicar novamente uma informação.
Ask for an explanation to be repeated.
sentences: Could you explain that again a little more slowly?
Você poderia explicar isso novamente um pouco mais devagar?
Do you mean we should meet before lunch?
Você quer dizer que devemos nos encontrar antes do almoço?
I understood the first part of your explanation.
Eu entendi a primeira parte da sua explicação.
b1-6-1.scene: Jo: The instructions weren't clear to me.
replies: Could you explain that again?
I understood everything; no need to explain.
Explain again you, now!

Could you + verb makes a clear, polite request.

explain — explicar

intent: Pergunte indiretamente onde fica o escritório.
Ask indirectly where the office is.
sentences: Could you tell me where the office is?
Você poderia me dizer onde fica o escritório?
Where is the office on this floor?
Onde fica o escritório neste andar?

O escritório fica ao lado da biblioteca.
b1-colaboracao-01.scene: Jo: Is where is the office correct after tell me?

Yes, always use where is the office.
No, omit office and the verb.
note: Na parte indireta, use ordem de afirmação.
In the indirect part, use statement word order.

intent: Confirme que o prazo é na sexta-feira.
Check that the deadline is Friday.
sentences: So, you mean the deadline is Friday?
Então, você quer dizer que o prazo é sexta-feira?
Could we extend the deadline until next week?
Poderíamos estender o prazo até a semana que vem?
We sent the proposal before Friday last week.
Nós enviamos a proposta antes de sexta-feira na semana passada.
b1-colaboracao-02.scene: Jo: Please send the file before the weekend.
replies: So, you mean the deadline is Friday?
I sent it last weekend.
You must mean Tuesday; I won't check.
note: You mean permite confirmar sua interpretação.
You mean lets you check your interpretation.

intent: Peça uma extensão do prazo até sexta-feira.
Ask for a deadline extension until Friday.
sentences: Could we extend the deadline until Friday?
Poderíamos estender o prazo até sexta-feira?
We agreed to finish the report by Tuesday.
Nós combinamos terminar o relatório até terça-feira.
Please confirm whether the deadline has already changed.
Por favor, confirme se o prazo já mudou.
b1-colaboracao-03.scene: Jo: The report is due tomorrow, but we need more time.
replies: Could we extend the deadline until Friday?
The deadline changed yesterday without agreement.
I'll ignore the deadline and send it someday.
note: Until Friday propõe o novo limite do prazo.
Until Friday proposes the new deadline limit.

intent: Peça orientação para enviar um arquivo.
Ask for help uploading a file.
sentences: Could you show me how to upload this file?

I uploaded the wrong file yesterday by mistake.
Eu enviei o arquivo errado ontem por engano.
Please tell me which folder contains the report.
Por favor, me diga qual pasta contém o relatório.
b1-colaboracao-04.scene: Jo: I can't find the upload button.
replies: Could you show me how to upload this file?
I finished uploading it without help.
You should know, so don't ask.
note: Explique a dificuldade e peça uma ação específica.
Explain the difficulty and request a specific action.

intent: Relate ter recebido uma bolsa de cor diferente.
Report receiving a bag of a different colour.
sentences: I ordered a blue bag but received a green one.
Eu pedi uma bolsa azul, mas recebi uma verde.

Could you send me the delivery address again?
Você poderia me enviar o endereço de entrega novamente?

Your shop is terrible; I won't explain.

Contrast the order and delivery to clarify the problem.

intent: Registre o acordo de enviar a proposta até terça.
Record the agreement to send the proposal by Tuesday.

replies: We'll send the proposal by Tuesday.
We might discuss it next month.
The proposal was approved before the meeting.
note: Agreed to registra uma decisão, não apenas uma sugestão.
Agreed to records a decision, not just a suggestion.

Summarise the main topic of the schedule change.

The article is mainly a list of addresses.
The club closed permanently without explaining why.

The main idea covers the text, not an isolated detail.

Highlight the changed time in the new notice.

O primeiro aviso lista os contatos do gerente.

Both notices say nine.

Compare the same information and check the update.

Choose the register to suit the recipient.

Justify choosing a quiet, free library.

The closing time is the only thing that matters.

Use relevant criteria to justify your choice.

Explain a delay and suggest meeting at the entrance.

Explain the problem and offer a concrete plan.

I turn it off deliberately before using it.

Acknowledge useful evidence despite a short trial.

Nós estendemos o teste para reunir evidências mais confiáveis.

Compare initial savings with ease of maintenance.

As duas opções custam o mesmo e exigem manutenção igual.

Make a deadline extension conditional on unchanged scope.

A assinatura anual tem desconto apenas durante o primeiro mês.
b2-autonomia-02.scene: Policy: Monthly plans pay full price. Annual plans receive a discount.
replies: In other words, only annual subscriptions qualify.
In other words, every monthly payment is discounted.
In other words, the discount lasts one month only.
note: Reformular deve preservar a restrição expressa por only.
A paraphrase must preserve the restriction expressed by only.

intent: Relate uma entrega que deveria ter ocorrido antes.
Report a delivery expected to happen earlier.
sentences: The replacement was supposed to arrive sometime last week.
O produto de substituição deveria ter chegado em algum momento na semana passada.
The replacement arrived earlier than expected and worked perfectly.
O produto de substituição chegou antes do esperado e funcionou perfeitamente.
The shop will arrange a replacement sometime next week.
A loja vai providenciar uma substituição em algum momento na próxima semana.
b2-autonomia-03.scene: Assistant: Your replacement hasn't arrived. When was it expected?
replies: It was supposed to arrive last week.
It arrived early and works perfectly.
There was never any expected delivery date.
note: Was supposed to indica uma expectativa anterior não cumprida aqui.
Was supposed to expresses an earlier expectation unmet here.

intent: Sinalize a passagem para os resultados da pesquisa.
Signal a transition to the survey results.
sentences: Turning to the survey, most respondents preferred evening classes.
Passando à pesquisa, a maioria dos participantes preferiu aulas noturnas.
The introduction described how the survey questions were designed.
A introdução descreveu como as perguntas da pesquisa foram elaboradas.
In conclusion, we need more evidence before recommending any changes.
Concluindo, precisamos de mais evidências antes de recomendar mudanças.
b2-autonomia-04.scene: You finished describing the method and now present the survey findings.
replies: Turning to the results, most respondents preferred evening classes.
As I said in the introduction, let's end here.
The findings are final proof about everyone's preferences.
note: Turning to orienta o público para o próximo tópico.
Turning to guides the audience to the next topic.

intent: Imagine uma consequência de conferir o arquivo antes.
Imagine the consequence of checking the file earlier.
sentences: If we had checked, we would have noticed the missing page.
Se tivéssemos conferido, teríamos percebido a página ausente.
If we check the file now, we will notice missing pages.
Se conferirmos o arquivo agora, perceberemos páginas ausentes.
We checked the file and noticed the missing page immediately.
Nós conferimos o arquivo e percebemos a página ausente imediatamente.
b2-autonomia-05.scene: Jo: We didn't check the file, so we missed the error.
replies: If we'd checked it, we'd have noticed the missing page.
If we check it yesterday, we will notice the page.
We checked it then and found every error.
note: Had + particípio com would have imagina outro passado.
Had + participle with would have imagines a different past.

intent: Recomende testar antes de assumir uma mudança permanente.
Recommend a trial before making a permanent change.
sentences: We recommend a trial before committing to a permanent change.
Nós recomendamos um teste antes de assumir uma mudança permanente.
We recommend a permanent change without testing any alternatives first.
Nós recomendamos uma mudança permanente sem testar alternativas antes.
The trial has already proved the change works everywhere.
O teste já provou que a mudança funciona em todos os lugares.
b2-autonomia-06.scene: Jo: Evidence is promising, but we don't know the long-term effects.
replies: We recommend a trial before a permanent change.
Let's make it permanent without further evaluation.
The evidence guarantees every long-term outcome.
note: Uma recomendação deve respeitar os limites da evidência disponível.
A recommendation should respect the limits of available evidence.

intent: Proponha testar os horários por duas semanas.
Suggest trying the schedule for two weeks.
sentences: Let's try the schedule for two weeks and review it.
Vamos testar os horários por duas semanas e avaliá-los.
We must adopt the schedule permanently without discussing the results.
Precisamos adotar os horários permanentemente sem discutir os resultados.
The previous schedule was cancelled before anyone tried it.
Os horários anteriores foram cancelados antes de alguém testá-los.
b2-acordos-cotidianos-01.scene: Housemates disagree about quiet hours and haven't tested either proposal.
replies: Let's try it for two weeks, then discuss how it went.
Let's make it permanent and never review it.
Disagreement means no schedule can ever work.
note: Um teste com revisão permite negociar sem assumir permanência.
A trial with a review allows negotiation without committing permanently.

intent: Condicione a recomendação à confirmação de acesso.
Make the recommendation conditional on confirmed access.
sentences: The museum sounds promising, provided we can confirm accessible entry.
O museu parece promissor, desde que possamos confirmar uma entrada acessível.
The museum is definitely accessible because the photos look welcoming.
O museu com certeza é acessível porque as fotos parecem acolhedoras.
The museum should be rejected before checking any access information.
O museu deve ser rejeitado antes de conferir informações de acesso.
b2-acordos-cotidianos-02.scene: Jo uses a wheelchair. The museum website doesn't mention step-free access.
replies: It sounds promising, as long as we confirm the access.
The photos prove it meets every access requirement.
No website detail means accessible entry is impossible.
note: As long as mantém a recomendação condicionada à verificação.
As long as keeps the recommendation conditional on verification.

intent: Sintetize convergência sem apagar diferenças entre os relatórios.
Synthesise agreement without erasing differences between reports.
sentences: Both reports highlight access, although they measure different outcomes.
Os dois relatórios destacam acesso, embora meçam resultados diferentes.
Both reports reach identical conclusions using exactly the same measures.
Os dois relatórios chegam a conclusões idênticas usando exatamente as mesmas medidas.
The reports contradict each other on every aspect of access.
Os relatórios se contradizem em todos os aspectos do acesso.
c1-sintese-01.scene: Report A links transport access to attendance. Report B links digital access to course completion.
replies: Both emphasise access, but examine different outcomes.
Both prove transport alone determines course completion.
Their different measures mean they share no relevant insight.
note: Uma síntese preserva convergência e limites de comparabilidade.
A synthesis preserves agreement and limits of comparability.

intent: Relacione a queda ao registro, sem afirmar menor demanda.
Link the decline to reporting without asserting lower demand.
sentences: The decline appears to reflect reporting changes rather than demand.
A queda parece refletir mudanças no registro, e não na demanda.
The decline conclusively proves that demand has permanently disappeared.
A queda prova conclusivamente que a demanda desapareceu permanentemente.
Demand increased before any changes to reporting were introduced.
A demanda aumentou antes da introdução de mudanças no registro.
c1-sintese-02.scene: Reported requests fell after the counting rule changed; independent bookings stayed stable.
replies: The decline appears to reflect reporting rather than demand.
Demand must have collapsed permanently.
The counting rule cannot influence reported figures.
note: Appears to calibra certeza; rather than contrasta explicações.
Appears to calibrates certainty; rather than contrasts explanations.

intent: Retome a discrepância como motivo para investigar a coleta.
Refer back to the discrepancy as the reason to investigate collection.
sentences: This discrepancy prompted the team to examine the collection method.
Essa discrepância levou a equipe a examinar o método de coleta.
The team accepted both conflicting figures without checking their sources.
A equipe aceitou os dois números conflitantes sem conferir suas fontes.
The collection method changed before any discrepancy had been identified.
O método de coleta mudou antes de qualquer discrepância ter sido identificada.
c1-sintese-03.scene: Two tables report different totals for the same period. The team investigates the counting method.
replies: This discrepancy prompted a review of how figures were collected.
The discrepancy confirms both totals are unquestionably correct.
The investigation caused a discrepancy that appeared earlier.
note: This discrepancy retoma a informação anterior e conecta a consequência.
This discrepancy refers back to previous information and connects the consequence.

intent: Preserve a ressalva dos autores sobre organizações menores.
Preserve the authors' caveat about smaller organisations.
sentences: The authors caution that the findings may not apply to smaller organisations.
Os autores alertam que os resultados talvez não se apliquem a organizações menores.
The authors guarantee that their findings apply equally to every organisation.
Os autores garantem que seus resultados se aplicam igualmente a todas as organizações.
Smaller organisations rejected the study before reading the authors' conclusions.
Organizações menores rejeitaram o estudo antes de ler as conclusões dos autores.
c1-sintese-04.scene: The study examined large firms only. Its authors warn against assuming the same results for small firms.
replies: The authors caution that applicability to smaller organisations remains uncertain.
The findings establish identical outcomes for every firm.
Small firms were tested and showed the same results.
note: Uma paráfrase mantém atribuição e grau de certeza.
A paraphrase preserves attribution and degree of certainty.

intent: Use a exceção para limitar o alcance da afirmação.
Use the exception to narrow the claim's scope.
sentences: The exception suggests that the claim needs to be narrowed.
A exceção sugere que a afirmação precisa ser delimitada.
The exception proves that every part of the argument is false.
A exceção prova que todas as partes do argumento são falsas.
The claim remains universal despite every documented exception to it.
A afirmação permanece universal apesar de todas as exceções documentadas.
c1-sintese-05.scene: A method helped most teams, but consistently failed where internet access was unreliable.
replies: The claim should be limited to teams with reliable access.
The method always works, including where it failed.
One exception proves it cannot help any team.
note: Um contraexemplo pode limitar a generalização sem negar todo benefício.
A counterexample can limit a generalisation without denying every benefit.

intent: Recomende implementação gradual para permitir avaliação.
Recommend phased implementation to allow evaluation.
sentences: On balance, phased introduction would allow the policy to be evaluated.
No conjunto, uma introdução gradual permitiria avaliar a política.
Immediate universal adoption would eliminate the need for any further evaluation.
A adoção universal imediata eliminaria a necessidade de outras avaliações.
The policy has already been evaluated under every possible condition.
A política já foi avaliada sob todas as condições possíveis.
c1-sintese-06.scene: The proposal is promising, but its effects on smaller teams remain unclear.
replies: A phased introduction would allow those effects to be evaluated.
Universal implementation would guarantee identical effects everywhere.
There is no uncertainty left to evaluate.
note: On balance apresenta uma avaliação ponderada dos prós e limites.
On balance introduces a weighed assessment of benefits and limits.

intent: Faça um pedido formal de comentários até quinta-feira.
Make a formal request for comments by Thursday.
sentences: We would appreciate receiving your comments by Thursday this week.
Nós agradeceríamos receber seus comentários até quinta-feira desta semana.
Hey, send me those comments whenever you feel like it.
Ei, me envie aqueles comentários quando tiver vontade.
We received your comments before the meeting last Thursday.
Nós recebemos seus comentários antes da reunião na quinta-feira passada.
c1-interacao-01.scene: You need to request feedback from a new external partner by Thursday.
replies: We would appreciate receiving your comments by Thursday.
Hey mate, whenever you feel like commenting is fine.
We already received your comments last week.
note: Ajustar o registro não deve alterar o pedido nem o prazo.
Changing register should not alter the request or the deadline.

intent: Identifique a necessidade compartilhada por duas equipes.
Identify a need shared by both teams.
sentences: What both teams need is a predictable process for urgent requests.
O que ambas as equipes precisam é de um processo previsível para pedidos urgentes.
One team's priorities must always override the other's without discussion.
As prioridades de uma equipe devem sempre prevalecer sobre as da outra sem discussão.
Both teams already agree on every detail of the current process.
Ambas as equipes já concordam com todos os detalhes do processo atual.
c1-interacao-02.scene: One team needs speed; the other needs advance notice. Both struggle with unpredictable urgent requests.
replies: Both need a predictable process that defines urgent requests.
Only speed matters; notice should always be ignored.
Their different priorities mean they share no needs.
note: Mediar começa por encontrar uma necessidade comum relevante.
Mediation starts by finding a relevant shared need.

intent: Peça para revisar o parágrafo final de forma indireta.
Indirectly ask to review the final paragraph.
sentences: Is there any chance we could revisit the final paragraph?
Há alguma chance de podermos revisar o parágrafo final?
The final paragraph has already been approved without any reservations.
O parágrafo final já foi aprovado sem nenhuma ressalva.
Who wrote the final paragraph before the review meeting began?
Quem escreveu o parágrafo final antes de começar a reunião de revisão?
c1-interacao-03.scene: Editor: Is there any chance we could revisit the final paragraph?
replies: Of course. Which part would you like to change?
Yes, it exists at the end of the document.
No, chance means the paragraph was deleted.
note: Um pedido indireto pode convidar uma ação, não só uma resposta literal.
An indirect request can invite action, not just a literal answer.

intent: Destaque que o entendimento veio somente após a revisão.
Emphasise understanding only after the review.
sentences: Only after the review did we understand the problem's full scale.
Somente após a revisão entendemos toda a dimensão do problema.
We fully understood the problem long before the review began.
Nós entendemos totalmente o problema muito antes de começar a revisão.
The review began only after everyone had solved the entire problem.
A revisão começou somente depois de todos resolverem o problema inteiro.
c1-interacao-04.scene: Jo: The scale was unclear until we reviewed all the cases.
replies: Only after the review did we understand the scale.
Only after the review we did understand the scale.
Only before the review had we already solved it.
note: Only after no início exige inversão do auxiliar e sujeito.
Initial only after requires inversion of auxiliary and subject.

intent: Separe uma estimativa inicial do orçamento aprovado.
Separate an initial estimate from the approved budget.
sentences: Let me distinguish between the initial estimate and the approved budget.
Permita-me distinguir a estimativa inicial do orçamento aprovado.
The initial estimate and approved budget are always identical amounts.
A estimativa inicial e o orçamento aprovado sempre têm valores idênticos.
The approved budget was rejected before the initial estimate existed.
O orçamento aprovado foi rejeitado antes da existência da estimativa inicial.
c1-interacao-05.scene: Audience: You mentioned two amounts. Which one is the approved budget?
replies: Let me distinguish the initial estimate from the approved budget.
Both amounts must be identical because both concern costs.
That question is irrelevant, so let's move on.
note: Delimite os termos antes de responder uma pergunta complexa.
Define the terms before answering a complex question.

intent: Registre o acordo sujeito à aprovação de acessibilidade.
Record the agreement as conditional on an accessibility review.
sentences: The agreement remains subject to a successful accessibility review.
O acordo continua sujeito a uma revisão de acessibilidade bem-sucedida.
The agreement is unconditional even if the accessibility review fails.
O acordo é incondicional mesmo se a revisão de acessibilidade falhar.
The accessibility review was cancelled because the agreement no longer exists.
A revisão de acessibilidade foi cancelada porque o acordo não existe mais.
c1-interacao-06.scene: Both sides agree to proceed only if the accessibility review passes.
replies: The agreement remains subject to a successful accessibility review.
Accessibility is optional because the agreement is unconditional.
The review failed, so approval is guaranteed.
note: Subject to registra uma condição ainda relevante ao acordo.
Subject to records a condition still relevant to the agreement.

intent: Reconheça relevância e limite causado por amostra estreita.
Acknowledge relevance and a limit caused by a narrow sample.
sentences: The study is relevant, but its narrow sample limits generalisation.
O estudo é relevante, mas sua amostra estreita limita a generalização.
The study's narrow sample proves its results apply to everyone.
A amostra estreita do estudo prova que seus resultados se aplicam a todos.
The sample's size makes every observation in the study meaningless.
O tamanho da amostra torna todas as observações do estudo sem sentido.
c1-evidencias-01.scene: A useful study included only one large urban school.
replies: It is relevant, but broader applicability remains uncertain.
It proves the same effects in every school.
It contains no useful observations because its sample is narrow.
note: Relevância não garante que a conclusão alcance todos os contextos.
Relevance does not guarantee applicability to every context.

intent: Descreva mudança curta sem alegar permanência.
Describe a short-term shift without claiming permanence.
sentences: The figures suggest a temporary shift rather than a permanent change.
Os números sugerem uma mudança temporária, e não uma mudança permanente.
The figures establish a permanent transformation across every possible setting.
Os números comprovam uma transformação permanente em todos os contextos possíveis.
The figures contain no information about any changes over time.
Os números não contêm informações sobre mudanças ao longo do tempo.
c1-evidencias-02.scene: Purchases increased during a one-week promotion, then returned to their earlier level.
replies: The figures suggest a short-term shift.
The promotion permanently changed everyone's behaviour.
No purchasing change occurred at any point.
note: Limite a afirmação ao período que os dados sustentam.
Limit the claim to the period supported by the data.

intent: Indique precisão suficiente para planejar, mas não ranquear diferenças pequenas.
Describe precision sufficient for planning but not ranking small differences.
sentences: The estimate supports planning, though not comparisons between very small differences.
A estimativa serve ao planejamento, mas não a comparações entre diferenças muito pequenas.
The estimate is precise enough to rank every tiny difference reliably.
A estimativa é precisa o suficiente para classificar cada diferença mínima com confiabilidade.
The estimate cannot support any decision because uncertainty always prevents planning.
A estimativa não pode apoiar decisões porque a incerteza sempre impede planejamento.
c1-evidencias-03.scene: The estimate is within ten percent. Two options differ by one percent.
replies: It supports broad planning, not a confident ranking of those options.
The one-percent difference is certainly meaningful.
Any uncertainty makes all planning impossible.
note: A precisão necessária depende da decisão que será tomada.
The precision required depends on the decision being made.

intent: Relacione uma taxa dobrada ao aumento de quatro casos.
Relate a doubled rate to four additional cases.
sentences: The rate doubled, but the increase meant only four additional cases.
A taxa dobrou, mas o aumento representou apenas quatro casos adicionais.
The rate doubled, so thousands of additional cases must have occurred.
A taxa dobrou, então milhares de casos adicionais devem ter ocorrido.
The number of cases stayed unchanged despite a doubling of the rate.
O número de casos ficou igual apesar de a taxa ter dobrado.
c1-evidencias-04.scene: Cases rose from four to eight with the same population size.
replies: The rate doubled, representing four additional cases.
The rate doubled, representing four thousand additional cases.
Doubling means there were no additional cases.
note: Combine mudança relativa e números absolutos para dar contexto.
Combine relative change and absolute numbers to provide context.

intent: Corrija a alegação usando o registro verificado.
Correct the claim using the verified record.
sentences: The verified record shows a schedule change, not a cancellation.
O registro verificado mostra uma mudança de horário, e não um cancelamento.
The online claim proves the event was cancelled despite the official schedule.
A alegação online prova o cancelamento do evento apesar dos horários oficiais.
The record says nothing about whether the event will still happen.
O registro não informa se o evento ainda acontecerá.
c1-evidencias-05.scene: A post claims cancellation. The official update says the event starts an hour later.
replies: The verified update confirms a later start, not cancellation.
The event was cancelled because a post says so.
The official update confirms every claim in the post.
note: Priorize a informação verificada ao corrigir uma alegação.
Prioritise verified information when correcting a claim.

intent: Recomende um piloto condicionado à revisão independente.
Recommend a pilot conditional on independent review.
sentences: A limited pilot is justified, provided access and outcomes are independently reviewed.
Um piloto limitado se justifica, desde que acesso e resultados sejam revisados de forma independente.
A permanent rollout is justified without reviewing access or outcomes.
Uma implantação permanente se justifica sem revisar acesso ou resultados.
The pilot should continue regardless of what independent reviewers find.
O piloto deve continuar independentemente do que revisores externos encontrarem.
c1-evidencias-06.scene: Evidence supports a small trial, but access and outcomes need independent monitoring.
replies: A limited pilot is justified, provided those aspects are independently reviewed.
The evidence guarantees success without any monitoring.
Independent review should be avoided so approval is easier.
note: Mantenha a recomendação ligada às condições que a justificam.
Keep the recommendation tied to the conditions that justify it.

intent: Verifique o pedido implícito e renegocie o prazo.
Check the implied request and renegotiate the deadline.
sentences: If you're asking me to lead this, we'd need to revise the deadline.
Se você está pedindo que eu lidere isso, precisaríamos revisar o prazo.
I'm certain you ordered me to lead this without changing any deadline.
Tenho certeza de que você me ordenou liderar isso sem mudar o prazo.
Since nobody asked, I will ignore the project's deadline entirely.
Como ninguém pediu, vou ignorar completamente o prazo do projeto.
c1-intencoes-e-impacto-01.scene: Jo: It would help to have someone experienced lead this. Your schedule is already full.
replies: If you're asking me to lead it, we'd need to revisit the deadline.
You definitely ordered me, so I'll ignore my other work.
I will take it on silently and keep every deadline.
note: Confirme a intenção antes de assumir um pedido indireto.
Check the intention before treating an indirect comment as a request.

intent: Converta feedback vago em uma proposta verificável.
Turn vague feedback into a testable proposal.
sentences: Would it help if I led with the finding and explained the caveat afterwards?
Ajudaria se eu começasse pelo resultado e explicasse a ressalva depois?
I'll remove every caveat so the finding sounds completely certain.
Vou remover todas as ressalvas para o resultado parecer totalmente certo.
Your feedback is too vague, so no revision can ever help.
Seu feedback é vago demais, então nenhuma revisão poderá ajudar.
c1-intencoes-e-impacto-02.scene: Editor: The opening feels unfocused. The finding arrives too late.
replies: Would it help if I led with the finding, then explained the caveat?
I'll delete the caveat and claim certainty.
I won't ask what change might improve the opening.
note: Proponha uma mudança concreta sem apagar a ressalva relevante.
Suggest a concrete change without removing the relevant caveat.

intent: Reconheça eficiência sem endossar os pressupostos do projeto.
Acknowledge efficiency without endorsing the scheme's assumptions.
sentences: Granting the scheme's efficiency does not entail endorsing its assumptions.
Reconhecer a eficiência do projeto não implica endossar seus pressupostos.
Recognising the scheme's efficiency establishes unconditional support for its assumptions.
Reconhecer a eficiência do projeto estabelece apoio incondicional aos seus pressupostos.
Rejecting every practical benefit is necessary before questioning the scheme's assumptions.
Rejeitar todos os benefícios práticos é necessário antes de questionar os pressupostos do projeto.
c2-nuance-01.scene: The writer praises faster processing but questions whether speed is an adequate measure of fairness.
replies: She concedes efficiency while challenging its sufficiency as a fairness measure.
Her praise establishes unconditional endorsement of the whole scheme.
Her criticism means she denies any improvement in speed.
note: Reconhecer um mérito não equivale a endossar a conclusão inteira.
Acknowledging a merit does not amount to endorsing the whole conclusion.

intent: Identifique ironia apoiada pelo contexto do atraso.
Identify irony supported by the delay's context.
sentences: Calling the delay a triumph of efficiency was hardly an unqualified compliment.
Chamar o atraso de triunfo da eficiência dificilmente foi um elogio sem ressalvas.
The reviewer praised the helpful employee without criticising her individual response.
O avaliador elogiou a funcionária prestativa sem criticar sua resposta individual.
The opening's literal praise remains entirely consistent with the failures described afterwards.
O elogio literal da abertura permanece totalmente coerente com as falhas descritas depois.
c2-nuance-02.scene: After forty minutes and duplicate forms, a reviewer calls the process a remarkable triumph of efficiency.
replies: The mismatch between praise and failures supports an ironic reading.
The phrase proves the reviewer welcomed every delay.
The wording proves personal hostility towards every employee.
note: A ironia depende da incongruência contextual, não de uma palavra isolada.
Irony depends on contextual incongruity, not an isolated word.

intent: Conteste uma pergunta que pressupõe um fracasso não demonstrado.
Challenge a question presupposing an unestablished failure.
sentences: The question presupposes a failure that the report has not established.
A pergunta pressupõe um fracasso que o relatório não demonstrou.
The report conclusively establishes the failure implied by every subsequent question.
O relatório demonstra conclusivamente o fracasso implícito em todas as perguntas posteriores.
The question asks whether failure occurred without assuming that it did.
A pergunta indaga se houve fracasso sem assumir que ele ocorreu.
c2-nuance-03.scene: Interviewer: Why did the pilot fail? The report records mixed results and reaches no verdict of failure.
replies: That question assumes a failure the report hasn't established.
The question neutrally asks whether the pilot failed.
Any mixed result proves complete failure by definition.
note: Verifique a premissa antes de aceitar a forma da pergunta.
Check the premise before accepting the question's framing.

intent: Preserve a negação parcial sobre os candidatos excluídos.
Preserve partial negation about excluded applicants.
sentences: Not all applicants were excluded, but the criteria remained unclear.
Nem todos os candidatos foram excluídos, mas os critérios continuaram pouco claros.
No applicants were excluded, and the criteria were entirely transparent.
Nenhum candidato foi excluído, e os critérios eram totalmente transparentes.
All applicants were excluded because the criteria ruled everyone out.
Todos os candidatos foram excluídos porque os critérios eliminaram todas as pessoas.
c2-nuance-04.scene: The report says not all applicants were excluded and criticises unclear selection criteria.
replies: It denies universal exclusion without specifying how many were excluded.
It states that nobody was excluded.
It confirms that every applicant was excluded.
note: Not all nega a totalidade; não significa none.
Not all denies universality; it does not mean none.

intent: Mostre o que a metáfora destaca e oculta.
Show what the metaphor foregrounds and obscures.
sentences: The metaphor foregrounds speed while obscuring the need for ongoing support.
A metáfora destaca velocidade enquanto oculta a necessidade de apoio contínuo.
The metaphor proves speed is the only legitimate criterion for assessing support.
A metáfora prova que velocidade é o único critério legítimo para avaliar apoio.
The metaphor has no possible influence on how readers interpret the proposal.
A metáfora não pode influenciar como leitores interpretam a proposta.
c2-nuance-05.scene: A training programme is called a launch pad. The proposal discusses starting quickly but omits follow-up support.
replies: The image emphasises the start while sidelining sustained support.
The image proves ongoing support is unnecessary.
The metaphor establishes how much support every participant receives.
note: Uma metáfora orienta atenção, mas não comprova o argumento.
A metaphor guides attention but does not prove the argument.

intent: Escolha a leitura mais estreita apoiada pela ressalva final.
Choose the narrower reading supported by the final qualification.
sentences: The passage permits two readings, but its final qualification favours the narrower one.
O trecho permite duas leituras, mas sua ressalva final favorece a mais estreita.
The passage permits only one reading and contains no qualification whatsoever.
O trecho permite apenas uma leitura e não contém nenhuma ressalva.
The final qualification expands the claim to include every conceivable circumstance.
A ressalva final amplia a afirmação para incluir todas as circunstâncias imagináveis.
c2-nuance-06.scene: Text: The policy benefits everyone involved, at least among those who can access the online form.
replies: The qualification limits everyone to those with access.
The qualification guarantees benefits to people without access.
The wording establishes equal benefits for all citizens.
note: Uma ressalva final pode limitar o alcance de uma afirmação ampla.
A final qualification can limit the scope of a broad claim.

intent: Reduza repetição preservando as ressalvas do argumento.
Reduce repetition while preserving the argument's qualifications.
sentences: The revision removes repetition without sacrificing the argument's important qualifications.
A revisão remove repetição sem sacrificar as ressalvas importantes do argumento.
The revision removes every qualification to make the conclusion sound certain.
A revisão remove todas as ressalvas para fazer a conclusão parecer certa.
The revision repeats each claim twice without clarifying the argument's scope.
A revisão repete cada afirmação duas vezes sem esclarecer o alcance do argumento.
c2-producao-01.scene: Original: The pilot may help some teams, although evidence remains limited. An editor asks for a shorter version.
replies: The pilot may help some teams; evidence remains limited.
The pilot will help every team.
Limited evidence proves the pilot cannot help anyone.
note: Economia textual não deve aumentar indevidamente a certeza da afirmação.
Textual economy should not unjustifiably increase a claim's certainty.

intent: Simplifique uma explicação mantendo sua precisão.
Simplify an explanation while preserving its accuracy.
sentences: A simpler explanation need not imply a less accurate one.
Uma explicação mais simples não precisa ser menos precisa.
A simpler explanation necessarily removes every uncertainty and exception from the claim.
Uma explicação mais simples necessariamente remove todas as incertezas e exceções da afirmação.
An accurate explanation must always contain every specialist term from the original.
Uma explicação precisa deve sempre conter todos os termos técnicos do original.
c2-producao-02.scene: A technical report finds an association but cannot establish causation. A public summary is needed.
replies: The factors are linked; the study doesn't show that one causes the other.
One factor certainly causes the other.
The study found nothing because causation wasn't established.
note: Troque jargão por clareza sem transformar associação em causa.
Replace jargon with clarity without turning association into causation.

intent: Atribua a crítica aos moradores sem adotá-la como fato.
Attribute the criticism to residents without adopting it as fact.
sentences: The report attributes criticism to residents without adopting every allegation itself.
O relatório atribui a crítica aos moradores sem adotar todas as acusações.
The report establishes every resident's allegation as an independently verified fact.
O relatório estabelece todas as acusações dos moradores como fatos verificados independentemente.
The report denies that any resident expressed criticism of the proposal.
O relatório nega que qualquer morador tenha expressado críticas à proposta.
c2-producao-03.scene: Report: Residents allege that consultation was inadequate. The report has not independently assessed that allegation.
replies: The report records the residents' allegation without endorsing it as established fact.
The report independently proves consultation was inadequate.
The report confirms no resident criticised consultation.
note: Discurso relatado preserva quem sustenta cada afirmação.
Reported discourse preserves who is responsible for each claim.

intent: Reconheça uma objeção válida sem tratá-la como decisão final.
Acknowledge a valid objection without treating it as decisive.
sentences: The objection is well founded, but does not itself settle the question.
A objeção é bem fundamentada, mas por si só não resolve a questão.
The objection is irrelevant because acknowledging it would require abandoning the argument.
A objeção é irrelevante porque reconhecê-la exigiria abandonar o argumento.
The objection conclusively settles every aspect of the decision without further comparison.
A objeção resolve conclusivamente todos os aspectos da decisão sem outras comparações.
c2-producao-04.scene: An option has a genuine accessibility drawback, but the alternatives also have unresolved accessibility barriers.
replies: The drawback is real, yet comparison with alternatives remains necessary.
Acknowledging the drawback proves every alternative is better.
Because alternatives have barriers, the drawback should be denied.
note: Uma objeção relevante precisa ser integrada, não ignorada nem absolutizada.
A relevant objection must be integrated, neither ignored nor treated as absolute.

intent: Mostre a avaliação acrescentada por merely adequate.
Identify the judgement added by merely adequate.
sentences: Describing the improvement as merely adequate adds a judgement beyond the figures.
Descrever a melhoria como meramente adequada acrescenta um julgamento além dos números.
Describing the improvement as adequate reports the exact figures without any evaluative framing.
Descrever a melhoria como adequada relata os números exatos sem qualquer enquadramento avaliativo.
The figures alone establish that every observer considered the improvement disappointing.
Os números sozinhos demonstram que todos os observadores consideraram a melhoria decepcionante.
c2-producao-05.scene: Two reports give the same increase. One calls it merely adequate; the other reports the number alone.
replies: Merely adequate introduces a restrictive evaluation not contained in the number.
The phrase changes the numerical increase itself.
Both formulations contain exactly the same evaluative stance.
note: Escolhas lexicais podem acrescentar julgamento sem mudar os números.
Lexical choices can add judgement without changing the numbers.

intent: Defenda uma conclusão que acomode incerteza.
Defend a conclusion that accommodates uncertainty.
sentences: A defensible conclusion accommodates uncertainty without surrendering reasoned judgement entirely.
Uma conclusão defensável acomoda a incerteza sem abandonar completamente o julgamento fundamentado.
A defensible conclusion must claim complete certainty about every possible outcome.
Uma conclusão defensável deve alegar certeza completa sobre todos os resultados possíveis.
Any uncertainty requires abandoning all comparison and refusing to reach any conclusion.
Qualquer incerteza exige abandonar toda comparação e recusar qualquer conclusão.
c2-producao-06.scene: Evidence favours a limited pilot, while long-term effects remain uncertain and access needs monitoring.
replies: A monitored pilot is defensible; permanent rollout is not yet established.
Uncertainty proves no decision can ever be justified.
Promising evidence guarantees permanent success everywhere.
note: Reconhecer incerteza permite uma conclusão delimitada e justificável.
Acknowledging uncertainty allows a bounded, justified conclusion.

intent: Leia a alusão como contraste entre promessa e resultado.
Read the allusion as a contrast between promise and outcome.
sentences: The headline echoes a familiar promise to expose how little has changed.
O título ecoa uma promessa conhecida para mostrar quão pouco mudou.
The headline repeats the promise to confirm that every expected change occurred.
O título repete a promessa para confirmar que todas as mudanças esperadas ocorreram.
The headline's familiar wording establishes the author's personal political allegiance beyond doubt.
A formulação conhecida do título estabelece sem dúvida a posição política pessoal do autor.
c2-estilo-cultura-01.scene: A headline repeats a famous promise of a fresh start above an article describing unchanged delays.
replies: The echoed promise highlights the gap between expectation and outcome.
The echo confirms that the fresh start succeeded completely.
The wording proves the author personally supports the original speaker.
note: Uma alusão ganha função pelo contraste construído no texto.
An allusion gains its function from the contrast built in the text.

intent: Separe a certeza citada da posição do narrador.
Separate quoted certainty from the narrator's stance.
sentences: The narrator reproduces the committee's certainty without necessarily sharing it.
O narrador reproduz a certeza do comitê sem necessariamente compartilhá-la.
The narrator's quotation establishes unquestioning agreement with everything the committee believes.
A citação do narrador estabelece concordância incondicional com tudo em que o comitê acredita.
The committee's certainty proves the author independently verified every prediction in the account.
A certeza do comitê prova que o autor verificou independentemente todas as previsões do relato.
c2-estilo-cultura-02.scene: Narrator: The committee called success inevitable. Yet subsequent events left its prediction unresolved.
replies: The committee's certainty is reported, not necessarily endorsed by the narrator.
The narrator guarantees success because the committee predicted it.
The author's own verified conclusion is that success occurred.
note: Diferencie voz citada, narrador e posição atribuível ao autor.
Distinguish the quoted voice, narrator, and position attributable to the author.

intent: Mostre uma tradução que deslocou o alvo da piada.
Identify a translation that shifted the joke's target.
sentences: A literal translation preserved the words but misplaced the joke's intended target.
Uma tradução literal preservou as palavras, mas deslocou o alvo pretendido da piada.
A literal translation necessarily preserves every cultural implication and rhetorical effect of humour.
Uma tradução literal necessariamente preserva todas as implicações culturais e efeitos retóricos do humor.
The joke's meaning depends only on dictionary equivalents regardless of the audience's expectations.
O sentido da piada depende apenas de equivalentes de dicionário, independentemente das expectativas do público.
c2-estilo-cultura-03.scene: The original mocks an inefficient process. The literal version sounds like an insult to the employee.
replies: The translation shifts the target from the process to the person.
The target is unchanged because the words are literal equivalents.
The employee must have been the original target too.
note: Preservar palavras não garante preservar alvo, registro e efeito.
Preserving words does not guarantee preserving target, register, and effect.

intent: Compare a atribuição de agência nas duas descrições.
Compare how the two descriptions assign agency.
sentences: The accounts describe the same transfer while assigning agency and benefit differently.
Os relatos descrevem a mesma transferência enquanto atribuem agência e benefício de formas diferentes.
The accounts describe entirely different transfers because their verbs have different evaluative effects.
Os relatos descrevem transferências totalmente diferentes porque seus verbos têm efeitos avaliativos distintos.
The shared transfer proves both accounts express identical views about agency and benefit.
A transferência compartilhada prova que ambos os relatos expressam visões idênticas sobre agência e benefício.
c2-estilo-cultura-04.scene: Account A: The city rescued the firm. Account B: The firm secured public funds. Both describe the same payment.
replies: The descriptions frame who acts and benefits differently.
Different framing proves the payment itself never occurred.
Both verbs assign identical agency and evaluation.
note: Compare fatos compartilhados e enquadramentos sem confundir os dois.
Compare shared facts and framing without confusing them.

intent: Organize etapas paralelas e reserve a ênfase final.
Organise parallel stages and reserve the final emphasis.
sentences: The revision clarifies the sequence, balances the clauses and highlights the consequence.
A revisão esclarece a sequência, equilibra as orações e destaca a consequência.
The revision scatters the stages across unrelated clauses and removes the consequence.
A revisão espalha as etapas por orações desconexas e remove a consequência.
The revision's rhythm guarantees the argument is factually correct without checking any evidence.
O ritmo da revisão garante a correção factual do argumento sem conferir evidências.
c2-estilo-cultura-05.scene: Editor: Keep the stages parallel and place the consequence at the end.
replies: First assess access, then test delivery, finally evaluate the effect.
Access was assessed; testing delivery; the effect somewhere.
Parallel rhythm proves every reported effect is true.
note: Ritmo e paralelismo organizam ênfase; não comprovam os fatos.
Rhythm and parallelism organise emphasis; they do not prove facts.

intent: Compare objetivos semelhantes e meios retóricos diferentes.
Compare similar aims and different rhetorical means.
sentences: The comparison reveals similar aims pursued through sharply different rhetorical means.
A comparação revela objetivos semelhantes buscados por meios retóricos claramente diferentes.
Similar aims prove both texts use identical rhetorical means and evaluative framing.
Objetivos semelhantes provam que os dois textos usam meios retóricos e enquadramentos avaliativos idênticos.
Different rhetorical means prevent the texts from sharing any communicative aim whatsoever.
Meios retóricos diferentes impedem os textos de compartilhar qualquer objetivo comunicativo.
c2-estilo-cultura-06.scene: Both texts seek support for reform. One uses collective pride; the other emphasises practical safeguards.
replies: Their aim converges, while their persuasive strategies differ.
The different strategies prove their aims cannot overlap.
Their shared aim makes every rhetorical choice identical.
note: Compare propósito e estratégia como dimensões distintas.
Compare purpose and strategy as distinct dimensions.

intent: Conteste a premissa de uma decisão já finalizada.
Challenge the premise that the decision was final.
sentences: That question assumes the decision was final, which is precisely what's disputed.
Essa pergunta assume que a decisão era final, exatamente o que está em disputa.
The disputed decision must have been final because the interviewer described it that way.
A decisão contestada deve ter sido final porque o entrevistador a descreveu assim.
The question neutrally asks whether any final decision was ever reached.
A pergunta indaga de forma neutra se alguma decisão final chegou a ser tomada.
c2-significado-em-disputa-01.scene: Interviewer: Why did you reverse the final decision? The minutes record only a provisional proposal.
replies: That question assumes finality, which the minutes do not establish.
We reversed the final decision, although no decision existed.
Calling it final proves the proposal was binding.
note: Conteste a premissa explicitamente antes de responder dentro dela.
Challenge the premise explicitly before answering within it.

intent: Repare ironia que foi entendida como elogio.
Repair irony that was understood as praise.
sentences: Calling the delay efficient was ironic; I meant to criticise the process.
Chamar o atraso de eficiente foi irônico; eu quis criticar o processo.
The listener's misunderstanding proves they should have recognised the irony without any explanation.
O mal-entendido do ouvinte prova que ele deveria ter reconhecido a ironia sem explicação.
Because the words sounded positive, the speaker must have intended an unqualified compliment.
Como as palavras soaram positivas, o falante deve ter pretendido um elogio sem ressalvas.
c2-significado-em-disputa-02.scene: You called a long delay a triumph of efficiency. A listener understood praise and looks confused.
replies: I meant that ironically; I was criticising the delay, not praising it.
You should have understood; I refuse to clarify.
Yes, every delay is proof of excellent efficiency.
note: Reparar explicita a intenção sem culpar quem interpretou diferente.
Repair makes the intention explicit without blaming a different interpretation.
